big_case.notes: Two real federal questions (categorical takings protection for intangible property; whether Puerto Rico has any federal-court immunity, left open in Financial Oversight v. CPI (2023)), but arising on a bounded license-plate/trademark licensing dispute with preservation complications (Penn Central disclaimed, other theories waived). The Court denied after two relists with no noted dissent or statement, so the case drew attention without becoming a vehicle. Moderate stakes.
